function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute CLI command: adb shell (device), sql (database), http (backend), read-file, write-file, find-files

steps.message: Review the 'tech-debt-review' channel on Mattermost for technical debt discussions.
Find tech-debt-review channel and read complexity analysis messages

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name='tech-debt-review'"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT message FROM posts WHERE channelid='tech_ch_id' AND deleteat=0 ORDER BY createat"

results.content: (5 messages with LaTeX complexity formulas for each module)

steps.message: Parse complexity scores. Highest: PaymentProcessor (47880). Others: AuthenticationService (13440), NotificationEngine (8400), ReportGenerator (4180), DataExporter (2160).
steps.reasoning_content: # Agent parses LaTeX formulas and computes scores

steps.message: Look up Sarah's phone from contacts

arguments.command: adb shell content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/data --projection data1 --where "display_name LIKE '%Sarah%' AND mimetype='vnd.android.cursor.item/phone_v2'"

steps.message: SMS Sarah with highest complexity module

steps.reasoning_content: # Agent creates contact with phone 15559876543 and company TechDebt Solutions

steps.message: Post sorted complexity table to channel

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "INSERT INTO posts (...) VALUES (...,'p11jse4oa3biikeeefcuggns9o','tech_ch_id',...,'| Module | Complexity |\n...|PaymentProcessor|47880|...',...)"
